title: ShopCoach with no results, failures, leaving the page and several axles
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with: a finding that has an empty note, a field flagged on several axles, and a Monitor finding (seed a template with checkbox and per-axle fields and set these).
custom_steps:
1. Note for the tester: forcing ShopCoach to return nothing or to fail cannot be done by hand — it is a developer/automated check. By hand, if an empty or failed result occurs naturally, confirm the user is told plainly and the work order is unchanged (never a blank panel).
2. Navigate away during drafting and confirm nothing is added to the work order.
3. Build from a finding whose note is empty and check the finding is still represented by a proposed line.
4. Check a field flagged on several axles produces a separate proposed line per flagged position (its own axle and row), not one merged line, and that a Monitor finding appears as a watch item rather than work to do now.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If ShopCoach returns no lines at all, the user is told so plainly and the work order is unchanged.
  • If the call to ShopCoach fails, the user is told that it failed, and is never left with an empty panel.
  • If the user navigates away while the drafting runs, nothing is added.
  • If a finding's note is empty, the finding is still sent and still represented.
  • If the same field is flagged on several axles, each flagged position reaches ShopCoach with its own axle and row so they are not collapsed into one line.
  • A Monitor finding arrives in the panel as a watch item the advisor can read as such, not as work to be done now.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9404 (S15 — Draft the lines with ShopCoach); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S15; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S15-E1: “If ShopCoach returns no lines at all, the user is told so plainly and the work order is unchanged”
  • S15-E2: “If the call to ShopCoach fails, the user is told that it failed. An empty panel is not an acceptable outcome, because there is no non-AI path to fall back to”
  • S15-E3: “If the user navigates away while the drafting runs, nothing is added”
  • S15-E4: “If a finding's note is empty, the finding is still sent and still represented. An empty note is not a reason to drop it”
  • S15-E5: “If the same field is flagged on several axles, each flagged position reaches ShopCoach with its own axle and row so they are not collapsed into one line by accident”
  • S15-E6: “A Monitor finding does not reach the panel as work to be done now. It arrives as a watch item the advisor can read as such”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
